## Goal
Bring docs/dev/ARCHITECTURE.md up to date with code merged since it was written: `monitor.py` (weekly read-only form checks), `exposure_models.py` (exposure lookup), the Assisted card and `submitters/assisted.py` (incl. `manual_email_token`), and the evidence kinds (EMAIL_RECEIVED, USER_ATTESTATION, PHONE_CALL_NOTE, POSTAL_RECEIPT).

## Acceptance criteria
- Module map + data-flow entries for each, with trust boundaries (what touches the network, what is read-only, what stores personal data and where).
- Every statement cites file:line on current main; nothing aspirational. Plain English.
- Note any place where code and existing docs disagree, as a finding (do not change other docs).
